result:
All 617 tests pass and there are no type errors. The fixes made:

- **`invitation-repository.ts`**: fixed `EXPIRY_UNIT_MS` (was hours, now days, so 14-day invitations actually last 14 days); unified a `pendingPredicate` (not accepted, not revoked, not expired) used by `listPendingInvitations` and `countPendingInvitations`, so revoked/expired invitations free their seat and stop showing as pending; added `findPendingInvitationByEmail` for duplicate detection and `findResendableInvitation` (ignores expiry, since resending an expired invitation is the normal case).
- **`member-repository.ts`**: `insertMember` now always creates an `active` member (the dead `invited`-status path meant accepted invitations never became real members); added `findMemberAnyStatus` and `reactivateMember` so a former member rejoining reuses their old row instead of colliding on the `(orgId, userId)` unique index.
- **`invitation-service.ts`**: `acceptInvitation` now checks the invitation's workspace hasn't been deleted, verifies the accepting user's email matches the invitation (case-insensitive), and reactivates a former member on rejoin (preserving member id, new role/inviter/join date) instead of blind-inserting; `inviteMembers` now refuses a batch that repeats an address or names an existing member/pending invitee; `resendInvitation` preserves the original role instead of downgrading to `member`.
- **`session-repository.ts` / `member-service.ts` / `organization-service.ts`**: removing a member clears their session's default workspace; deleting an org revokes its pending invitations and clears every session defaulting to it.
- **`notification-service.ts` / `notification-preference-repository.ts`**: notifications and digest recipients are now filtered to current active members, so removed members stop receiving either.
